Cognates include Karelian lounat (“evening/main meal”), Veps louna, Votic lõunõd (“south, lunch”), Estonian lõuna (“south, lunch”) and Komi-Permyak лун (lun). parole.significato: waste fibres, scutching tow; tangled fibres of hemp or cotton, often with shives
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *tappura, probably from Proto-Finno-Permic *tappa. Alternatively, possibly equivalent to tappaa + -ura, from dialectal use of tappaa to signify threshing of cotton or hemp.
